lcc_original: 凡有血肉、而在地上行動的，飛鳥、牲口、走獸、和在地上滋生的各樣昆蟲、以及所有的人、都溺死；
notes: LCC reverses UNV word order in opening clause: UNV '在地上有血肉的動物' → LCC '有血肉、而在地上行動的'; SNs follow LCC word order: 有血肉<WH01320> then 在<WAH05921>地上<WH0776>行動的<WH07430>.
UNV implicit {<WAH09002>} (waw conjunction before 爬) is realized explicitly as LCC 和; braces dropped → 和<WAH09002>.
UNV implicit {<WAH03605>} (כֹּל before שֶׁרֶץ) is realized explicitly as LCC 各樣; braces dropped → 各樣<WAH03605>.
LCC 滋生 (H8317, 'swarm/teem') = UNV 爬 — same Hebrew root, different Chinese rendering; morphology <WTH8802> attached to 滋生.
LCC 牲口 = UNV 牲畜 (both H929 בְּהֵמָה); LCC 溺死 renders H1478 גָּוַע with drowning-specific nuance not present in UNV 死了 — SN still attaches directly.
